stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind='ClassDef'

stages.name: single_decorators
stages.query: SELECT d.__path,d.parent fn,d.id root,coalesce(c.kind,d.kind) kind,coalesce(c.name,d.name) name FROM a d LEFT JOIN a c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.parent=d.id AND c.field='func' AND d.kind='Call' WHERE d.field='decorator_list'

stages.name: graph_classes
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM classes n WHERE n.fn IS NULL AND n.cls IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM classes earlier WHERE earlier.__path=n.__path AND earlier.name=n.name AND earlier.fn IS NULL AND earlier.cls IS NULL AND earlier.id<n.id)

stages.name: graph_method_candidates
stages.query: SELECT f.*,owner.name owner_name FROM functions f JOIN classes owner ON owner.__path=f.__path AND owner.id=f.cls WHERE f.fn IS NULL AND owner.fn IS NULL AND owner.cls IS NULL

stages.name: graph_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.* FROM graph_method_candidates m WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM graph_method_candidates later WHERE later.__path=m.__path AND later.owner_name=m.owner_name AND later.name=m.name AND later.id>m.id)

stages.name: top_definitions
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.line,n.name,CASE n.kind WHEN 'ClassDef' THEN 'class' ELSE 'function' END symbol_kind FROM a n WHERE n.kind IN ('ClassDef','FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef') AND n.fn IS NULL AND n.cls IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.line,t.name,CASE n.kind WHEN 'TypeAlias' THEN 'typealias' ELSE 'assign' END FROM a n JOIN a t ON t.__path=n.__path AND t.parent=n.id AND t.field IN ('targets','name') AND t.kind='Name' WHERE n.kind IN ('Assign','TypeAlias') AND n.fn IS NULL AND n.cls IS NULL

stages.name: top_symbols
stages.query: SELECT n.*,(SELECT min(first.id) FROM top_definitions first WHERE first.__path=n.__path AND first.name=n.name) insertion FROM top_definitions n WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM top_definitions later WHERE later.__path=n.__path AND later.name=n.name AND later.id>n.id)
